releaseNotes.zh-Hans: 接入蓝牙协议基础层、BLE 扫描/连接/读写客户端和蓝牙维护页面；在未配置 GATT UUID 时仅允许扫描并清晰提示缺配置，连接、读取、写入保持禁用。参数按协议点表紧凑分组，隐藏 AFE/OCD/OTD 等内部器件参数，并修复从“我的”进入蓝牙维护页后无法返回的问题。
releaseNotes.zh-Hant: 接入藍牙協議基礎層、BLE 掃描/連線/讀寫用戶端和藍牙維護頁面；在未配置 GATT UUID 時僅允許掃描並清楚提示缺配置，連線、讀取、寫入保持停用。參數按協議點表緊湊分組，隱藏 AFE/OCD/OTD 等內部器件參數，並修復從「我的」進入藍牙維護頁後無法返回的問題。
releaseNotes.en: Added the Bluetooth protocol foundation, BLE scan/connect/read/write client, and Bluetooth maintenance UI. When GATT UUIDs are not configured, scanning remains available with a clear missing-configuration warning while connect/read/write stay disabled. Parameters are compactly grouped from the protocol table, AFE/OCD/OTD internal device parameters are hidden, and returning from Bluetooth maintenance back to Profile is fixed.
